design: Edge maps its X11 frame using the exact xenia_canary identity Nougat v53 expects.
Edge waits after frame mapping and before returning from OpenImpl.
Nougat's existing EmulatorHost reparents that frame while no Vulkan/XCB render surface exists yet.
Edge verifies a NougatMediaSuite ancestor before continuing.
Only then does normal Xenia Edge graphics initialization continue.
